Weapon Kills while inside an Empowering or Healing Rift grant Blood Magic.
Blood Magic halts the duration of the Rift.

Blood Magic Duration:
5 seconds per kill, up to a maximum of 15 seconds.

Weapon Kills while inside an Empowering or Healing Rift grant Blood Magic.
Blood Magic halts the duration of the Rift.

Blood Magic Duration:
5 seconds per kill, up to a maximum of 15 seconds.

While staning in a Rift:
• Grants 2 Stacks of Subclass-Matching Weapon Surge
• Kills grant Blood Magic for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 15 seconds

Blood Magic pauses the duration of the Rift for as long as it is active.

While staning in a Rift or a Well of Radiance:
• Grants 2 Stacks of Subclass-Matching Weapon Surge
• Kills grant Blood Magic for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 15 seconds

Blood Magic pauses the duration of the Rift for as long as it is active. Doesn't apply to Well of Radiance.

While standing in a Rift or a Well of Radiance:

• Kills grant Blood Magic for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 15 seconds

Blood Magic pauses the duration of the Rift for as long as it is active. Doesn't apply to Well of Radiance.
